title: Incoming Packages Plugin Configuration
description: Show packages headed your way, sourced from Home Assistant (Mail and Packages), AfterShip, or a built-in demo.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the Incoming Packages plugin

display_duration.description: How long to display the plugin in the rotation, in seconds

provider.description: Where to read package data from. 'homeassistant' reads the Mail and Packages integration; 'aftership' reads the AfterShip API; 'mock' shows built-in demo data.

ha_base_url.description: Home Assistant base URL, e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123

ha_token.description: Home Assistant long-lived access token (Profile > Long-Lived Access Tokens)

api_key.description: AfterShip API key (only used when provider is 'aftership')

highlight_today.description: Prioritize and accent-color packages arriving today

accent_color.description: RGB accent color for the 'arriving today' highlight

show_carrier_logo.description: Show a carrier badge on each card

show_usps_mail_image.description: Include the USPS Informed Delivery mail count / image when available

include_delivered.description: Also show packages already delivered today

max_cards.description: Maximum number of cards to rotate through

rotation_interval.description: Seconds each card is shown before rotating

update_interval.description: How often to refresh package data from the provider, in seconds

entity_prefix.description: Home Assistant entity id prefix for the Mail and Packages sensors

scroll_enabled.description: Marquee-scroll text that is too long to fit

timezone.description: Override timezone for 'today' (leave empty to use the system/global timezone)
